title: US Visa Interview Questions: Common Questions and How to Answer Them (B1/B2 and F-1)
seoTitle: US Visa Interview Questions for Indians (B1/B2, F-1)
seoDescription: Common US visa interview questions for Indians, what the officer checks under Section 214(b), how to answer honestly, and when to reapply after a refusal.
excerpt: Grouped by theme, with what each question tests under US law, what happens at the consulate, the 2025–26 rule changes, and when it is worth reapplying after a 214(b) refusal.
